title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature provides detailed logging of incoming requests and errors, allowing for better debugging and issue tracking. It will include logging of request metadata, response codes, and error messages. This will improve the overall production readiness of the framework by providing valuable insights into application performance and potential issues
testCases: Test logging of requests with errors
Test logging of requests with invalid metadata
acceptance: Logging is enabled by default, logs are written to a file, and logs include request metadata, response codes, and error messages
reason: Improved debugging and issue tracking capabilities are essential for a production-ready framework, and detailed request logging is a key aspect of this
